args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy (error rate 0.18, unhealthy in all regions). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback verified.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) across all regions, and opened a SEV2 incident.

**What I did:**
1. **Diagnosed** — checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all regions, unhealthy with an 18% error rate. Deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the last healthy production release.
2. **Rolled back** — reverted all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0. Rollback was verified.
3. **Opened incident** — created SEV2 `INC-0001` for checkout-api, paging on-call, describing the failure and the rollback.

transcript.content:
I rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) across all regions, and opened a SEV2 incident.

**What I did:**
1. **Diagnosed** — checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all regions, unhealthy with an 18% error rate. Deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the last healthy production release.
2. **Rolled back** — reverted all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0. Rollback was verified.
3. **Opened incident** — created SEV2 `INC-0001` for checkout-api, paging on-call, describing the failure and the rollback.
